title: Up or Down · Quick round
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Up or Down · Quick round with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: A partner prepares two comfortably hummed pitches, one higher and one lower. The partner hums them in a chosen order; the lead says whether the pitch rose or fell. The lead identifies the direction correctly. Give each attempt 30 seconds. Each player leads two turns and earns one point per success. Highest score wins; ties are shared.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 2–8 players; materials: A timer.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Up or Down, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The lead identifies the direction correctly.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
The group ends the round before anyone plays.
recall.why: The lead identifies the direction correctly.
